tools.name: site_check
tools.description: Check a whole website's security in seconds: the TLS certificate (trusted by browsers, expiry, the names it covers), the security headers (HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, framing, nosniff, referrer and permissions policies), cookie flags, whether http:// moves to https://, the domain's mail records (

tools.name: ip_check
tools.description: Fraud intelligence for any IPv4 or IPv6 address: a 0-100 fraud score, risk band, and whether it is a VPN, proxy, Tor node, relay, datacenter host or mobile connection. Also returns the owning network (ASN, ISP, organisation), geolocation, reverse DNS, abuse history and how much of its /24 subnet is

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Check an email address before you let it create an account: whether it is disposable or throwaway, a role address, on a community blacklist, or tied to a domain that hands out temporary mailboxes. Free, no key.

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: Reputation for a domain: whether it hands out disposable mailboxes and whether it appears in the phishing dataset, with a risk level. One unauthenticated lookup, no key.

tools.name: ip_reports
tools.description: The community abuse reports filed against an IP: what it was reported for, when, and by how many distinct reporters. Use it when you want the evidence behind a score rather than the score alone.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_check, request_api_key, claim_api_key · Private data: site_check, request_api_key, claim_api_key · Public sink: email_check, request_api_key, claim_api_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_check, request_api_key, claim_api_key · Private data: site_check, request_api_key, claim_api_key · Public sink: email_check, request_api_key, claim_api_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
